title: pix_opencv_of_hs
description: `pix_opencv_of_hs` applies the Horn–Schunck optical-flow algorithm to a video stream to analyze movement. It provides the largest movement amplitude, the angle of the block with maximum movement, and the average block-movement angle (both in degrees from -180 to 180), while marking the maximum with a white arrow; the help patch warns that the object is experimental.
